name: Shadow’s Ring
body:
Aura moderate transmutation ; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears and functions as an improved ring of shadows. If the wearer dies, however, 1d4 rounds later she comes back as a greater shadow.

This ring can be removed by casting remove curse upon it, destroying the ring in the process.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of shadows, improved

Identification DC 35
False Identification DC 25
